text: Five hundred years ago, a man sat alone in a small farmhouse outside Florence, and wrote a book that rulers still study today. He asked one question. Is it better to be loved... or feared? His answer will change how you see every room you walk into.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Listen to the reed, how it tells a tale, complaining of separations. Rumi says: everyone who is left far from his source wishes back the time when he was united with it. So ask yourself tonight. What are you missing?
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
